object_description: large compact two-story volume with a central core
design_condition: The precisely placed volume is aligned along the road near the middle of the site, forming new outdoor spaces and establishing itself as the central element of the campus.

positive.statement: The precisely placed volume, with sensitive proportions, forms exciting outdoor spaces and achieves high urban-development quality.
The load transfer is consistently and clearly thought out, with generous ceiling spans and a central stabilizing core.
The combinable auditorium and lunch table provide varied internal and external event and usage options.
The upper-floor plan reflects very good spatial and operational connections.
The lightweight timber structure offers a high degree of flexibility.
The cost-conscious compactness of the building is convincing.
The proposal is recognized as an exciting, identity-forming contribution.

negative.statement: The choice of connection levels and the ceiling system above the ground floor should be checked.
The separation between the upper floor and basement is incomprehensible, and the basement quality cannot match that of the upper floor.
The basement atriums offer little daylight and do not replace the necessary connection to the outside.
The highly transparent facade is applied inconsistently, denying an important part of the building the same quality.
The floor-to-ceiling vertically divided glass facade appears unfortunate in places and creates potential conflicts.
Complete glazing behind the auditorium stage does not make much sense.
The escape balcony reinforces the impression that more than one escape staircase is necessary.
